verdict.rationale: Signifyd documents a Checkout (Pre-Auth) endpoint meant to be called before the payment gateway, implying synchronous scoring ahead of authorization, but the docs don't clearly state a guaranteed real-time SLA or describe the response as a synchronous ML risk score returned inline — the more detailed workflow (getDecision) appears to be a separate retrieval call rather than an inline synchronous score. missing for 10: explicit documentation of response latency/SLA guarantees, explicit statement that the Checkout call returns a synchronous ML score in the same response, and independent/hands-on confirmation of real-time behavior.
